title: Pricing
description: Simple plans that grow with you. Try any paid plan free for 14 days.
metaDescription: A pricing page template: plans with monthly and yearly billing, a comparison and FAQ.

growth.name: Growth
growth.description: For growing teams that ship every week.

scale.name: Scale
scale.description: For companies with more data and more people.
features: Up to 2 million events a month

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: For custom limits, contracts and security reviews.

change.question: Can I change plans later?
change.answer: Yes. Upgrade or downgrade at any time; the difference is prorated on your next invoice.

trial.question: What happens after the trial?
trial.answer: You choose a plan, or the workspace moves to Starter. Nothing is deleted.

discounts.question: Do you offer discounts?
discounts.answer: Yearly billing saves about 20%. Non-profits and schools get 50% off — just ask.

payment.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: Cards, PayPal and bank transfer for yearly plans.
